literal_meaning: বাড়ার অত্যধিক বৃদ্ধি (reduplicative form emphasizing increase)
figurative_meaning_en: Tautological compound word; extreme prosperity or flourishing
example_sentences_in_english: The team's extreme flourishing is baffling.
The business's skyrocketing prosperity has surprised everyone.
note: This is a classic Bengali reduplicative idiom used to denote emphatic increase in fortune or success.
